menu.title: Ninjoy menu
edit.hint: Drag a group to move it. Tap it to resize it or tune its zones.
notice.noFullscreen: This browser cannot go fullscreen. On iPhone, tap Share → Add to Home Screen and open Ninjoy from there.
notice.noVibration: This device does not support vibration.
notice.motionDenied: Motion access was denied, so the gyroscope stays off.
notice.noMotion: This device has no motion sensor available, so the gyroscope stays off.
notice.motionInsecure: Motion sensors need a secure (HTTPS) connection, so the gyroscope stays off.
session.unavailable: Ninjoy is not reachable. Trying again…
session.notAllowed: Right now only the PC can create new controllers.
session.openedElsewhere: This controller was opened in another tab or window.
session.updateNeeded: This page and Ninjoy on the PC are different versions. Update Ninjoy and reload.
lobby.title: Pick a controller
lobby.emptyNoCreate: No controllers yet. Ask the host to create one.
notice.turnSideways: Turn your device sideways to play.
explain.title: Open the Ninjoy controller
explain.why: Ninjoy uses a secure connection with a certificate made by your PC, so motion sensors and fullscreen work. The first time, your browser shows a security warning. That is expected: the connection stays inside your home network.
explain.iphone: iPhone: tap “Show Details”, then “visit this website”, then “Visit Website”.
explain.once: You only need to do this once on this device.
explain.noSecure: The secure connection is not available on this PC right now. You can still play without motion sensors.
